title: Apache Ossie Core Metadata Specification
description: JSON Schema for validating a single Apache Ossie semantic model document

Dialect.description: Expression language a metric or field expression is declared in. Any non-empty string is accepted. OSSIE_SQL_2026 is the only dialect this specification defines; others are opaque to Ossie. See extensions/dialects.md.

Vendor.description: Vendor name for non-portable extensions. Any non-empty string is accepted. See extensions/vendors.md.

instructions.description: Instructions for AI on how to use this entity

NonportableExtension.description: Vendor-specific state that Ossie carries and does not interpret. Portable behavior does not depend on it.

data.description: Vendor-specific data as a structured object. The core schema does not reference the structure under data: no reserved key and no common sub-key. Keys are entirely vendor-defined. Values must be JSON-representable. Ossie carries the object but does not interpret it. See core-spec/spec.md#non-portable-extensions.

sql.description: Primary, portable expression written in OSSIE_SQL_2026. When both this field and an OSSIE_SQL_2026 entry in `dialects` are present, this field is authoritative.

DataType.description: Logical data type for fields and metrics, independent of role (e.g. dimension vs fact) and physical representation. `Decimal` is exact base-10 with unspecified precision and scale; `Float` is approximate. `DateTime` has no timezone or offset, while `DateTimeTz` identifies an instant using offset or timezone context but does not guarantee preservation of a named timezone. Omit `datatype` when unknown. `Opaque` means the type is outside the portable vocabulary. A vendor may record its own type name under `nonportable_extensions`; that record is not part of the portable type.

is_time.description: Temporal-role marker. When true, consumers that distinguish time dimensions (e.g. for time-series analysis or temporal filtering) should treat this field as a time dimension. This is a *role* flag, independent of the field's data type: a field with `is_time: true` may carry any `datatype` (e.g. `Integer` for a year grain, `String` for a month name, as well as temporal data types). When `is_time` is unset, it defaults to `true` if `datatype` is one of `Date`, `Time`, `DateTime`, or `DateTimeTz`, and `false` otherwise. Set `is_time: false` explicitly to opt a temporal-typed column (such as an audit timestamp) out of time-dimension treatment.

Field.description: Row-level attribute for grouping, filtering, and metric expressions

name.description: Unique identifier for the field within the dataset

Dataset.description: Logical dataset representing a business entity (fact or dimension table)

source.description: Reference to underlying physical table/view (database.schema.table) or query

primary_key.description: Dataset fields that uniquely identify rows

unique_keys.description: Array of unique key definitions, each a list of dataset fields

fields.description: The dataset's declared fields. Within the dataset, field names and metric names share one namespace and must all be unique across the two.

metrics.description: Dataset-scoped metrics: aggregations evaluated at this dataset's row level, for measures that semantically belong to the dataset. The expression references this dataset's declared fields by single-part (unqualified) name, and columns of the dataset's source as source.column. It must resolve entirely within this dataset; an expression that must reference another dataset belongs in the model-scoped metrics instead. Within the dataset, field names and metric names share one namespace and must all be unique across the two.

from.description: Dataset on the many side of the relationship

to.description: Dataset on the one side of the relationship

from_columns.description: Array of field names in the 'from' dataset (foreign key fields)

to_columns.description: Array of field names in the 'to' dataset (primary or unique key fields)

Metric.description: Quantitative measure defined on business data

description.description: Human-readable description of what the metric measures

SemanticModel.description: Top-level container representing a complete semantic model

name.description: Unique identifier for the semantic model

metrics.description: Model-scoped metrics: aggregations that span datasets or need to be aware of cross-dataset concepts. Expressions reference fields by multi-part name (dataset.field) and may combine fields from more than one dataset. Names must be unique across the model. See core-spec/spec.md#metric-scoping.
